entries.final_answer: Converge now: doctrine's pack_paths.py::_resolve_built_in will delegate to the new kernel-owned primitive as part of this mission, one canonical implementation.
entries.question: FR-004's new kernel-owned sibling-path-resolution primitive and doctrine's existing pack_paths.py::_resolve_built_in implement a near-identical algorithm. Should this mission make doctrine's pack_paths.py delegate to the new kernel primitive (one canonical implementation, more surface area touched now), or ship the kernel primitive standalone and leave the convergence as a named follow-up (smaller diff now, two implementations survive a bit longer)?
